SAFETY INSURANCE GROUP INC Q2 2026: Revenue $325.7M, EPS $2.36— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
SAFETY INSURANCE GROUP INC reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $325.7M and net income of $34.52M, driven by higher premiums and favorable underwriting trends offset in part by elevated weather-related claims; diluted EPS was $2.36 for the quarter.

Financial Highlights

  • Revenue was $325.7M for Q2 2026, compared with $316.3M in Q2 2025; YoY change 3.0%.
  • Net income was $34.52M for Q2 2026, compared with $28.94M in Q2 2025; YoY change 19.3%.
  • Diluted EPS was $2.36 for Q2 2026, compared with $1.95 in Q2 2025; YoY change 21.0%.

Business Highlights

  • Net earned premiums grew about 5.0% year-to-date to $582.6M, supported by rate increases despite modest declines in policy counts.
  • The company continues to rely on its independent agent network (797 agents across 1,063 locations) and is pruning underperforming agencies.
  • Severe winter storms generated roughly 1,800 claims totaling about $42.7M, pushing the six-month loss ratio to 76.0% and increasing reserves.
  • Underwriting momentum included improved private passenger accident frequency and approved rate filings across Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Maine, which raised average premium per policy.
  • SAFETY Insurance entered a merger agreement to be acquired for $105.00 per share, which is expected to trigger transaction costs and potential integration activity.

Original SEC Filing: SAFETY INSURANCE GROUP INC [ SAFT ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

data.title: Meridian Corp Q2 2026: Net income $5.8M, EPS $0.48— 10-Q Summary
data.description:
Meridian Corp reported second-quarter 2026 results, with net income of $5.8M, up $0.215M (3.8% YoY), and diluted earnings per share of $0.48 versus about $0.49 in the year-ago quarter. Year-to-date net income was $7.8M, down $0.178M (2.2%) versus the first half of 2025, with diluted EPS YTD of $0.64 compared with $0.7 a year earlier.

Financial Highlights

  • Net income: $5.8M for Q2 2026, up $0.215M (3.8%) from Q2 2025.
  • Diluted EPS: $0.48 for Q2 2026, essentially flat to a slight decline versus about $0.49 in Q2 2025.
  • Net income (YTD): $7.8M for 1H 2026, down $0.178M (2.2%) year over year; diluted EPS YTD $0.64 versus $0.70 in 1H 2025.

Business Highlights

  • Net interest income increased year over year, driven by lower funding costs and higher loan volumes, supporting core banking revenue momentum.
  • Mortgage banking volumes and sales strengthened, with mortgage sales up 17% quarter over quarter, lifting mortgage banking income despite lower margins.
  • Wealth management growth: assets under management increased roughly 9% since year-end, contributing to higher wealth fees.
  • Operational investments ramped up, including higher technology spending for data processing and software, and the opening of the first full-service Florida branch in Bonita Springs.
  • Credit and risk: proactive loan reviews, higher charge-offs and increased allowance for credit losses, with heightened focus on distressed commercial real estate and SBA loan portfolios.

Original SEC Filing: Meridian Corp [ MRBK ] - 10-Q - Aug. 07, 2026

Posting of the Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting and Explanatory Memorandum
